_schema_note: Generic coverage-map schema (same as ai_buildout): verticals -> companies [{id, name, ticker?, cik?, kind: public|private, status?, note?}], edges [{from, to, kind, label, amount_bn?, date?, source, confidence}], aggregates, risk_notes. The generic fetchers (fetch_universe_capex, fetch_universe_graph) take this universe_id with no TSV-specific hardcoding. status: operating | notice_filed | announced | preparing | positioned | rumored | active.

excluded: synthetics / tokenized linked securities / security-based swaps
order.issuer_veto: 30-day written issuer notice before listing third-party tokens; issuer may object within that window
order.notice_mechanics: Public website notice >=30 calendar days before operating; written notice to tradingandmarkets@sec.gov within 1 business day of publication. ~30 lettered disclosure items; revised notices on 5-business-day / 20-day / quarterly cycles.
other_conditions: auditable public smart contracts on permissionless ledger
trading halts concurrent with primary listing exchange
order.pairing: tokenized NMS stock <-> tokenized NMS stock | non-security crypto (e.g. GENIUS Act payment stablecoin) | tokenized money market fund

risk_notes: No TSV operating notice (Condition C) had been published on any operator website as of 2026-09-20; SEC staff expect first notices 'next quarter' (Sept 22 interview). Earliest possible trading: 2026-10-17.
No central SEC registry exists — Condition C notices live on each operator's own website; written notice goes to tradingandmarkets@sec.gov within 1 business day of publication.
Issuer veto: any S&P 500 / Russell 1000 constituent can block third-party tokenization of its shares within 30 days of issuer notice.
Only ~15.6% of the $3.06B tokenized-stock market fits the order (cleansky.io, 2026-09-20): transfer-restricted issuer tokens need permissioned AMMs; synthetic/derivative tokens are excluded outright.
Robinhood's current EU stock tokens and Kraken's xStocks do not qualify (derivative contracts / no shareholder rights).
Backed (xStocks) is not a US person and cannot operate a TSV.
Covered Firm exemption is contingent on a qualifying TSV operating — BTCS/Imperium has no launch date or capital commitment.
Exemption expires 2026-09-17 -> 2031-09-17; SEC may modify under Section 36; public comments open under File No. 4-927.
